steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 15-second ad for [your product], 16:9 at 1920x1080, from the "24-one-time-bundle" template in lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates (MIT, rendered with HyperFrames).

Setup: clone https://github.com/lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates into ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates, then run `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 doctor` and fix anything it reports (it needs Node.js 22 or newer, FFmpeg and Chrome).

The film, scene by scene:
1. 20 subscription cards pile up while a monthly-spend pill counts up; headline with RGB glitch
2. three hard beats (Every. / Single. / Month.) on a red tint, then the cards swirl into a vortex
3. the lockup: diamond mark with chevrons, wordmark wipes in over a blue floor grid
4. four full-screen tool slides with outlined background words and flip transitions
5. a tilted 3D wall of product screenshots, headline rises letter by letter, 20 feature chips light up
6. white wipe to the deal: struck-through subscription prices, circled one-time price
7. counter rolls to the customer number with rays, stars, rating and guarantee pill
8. end lockup with tagline and a URL pill with a shine

Before you change anything, learn [your product] from [your product URL] and ask me only for what you cannot find: its name, what it does in one line, the copy each scene needs, and two or three brand colours as #rrggbb. The demo brand, names, prices, numbers, ratings and quotes are placeholders: replace every one with something true for my product, or remove it. Never ship a made-up number or testimonial.

Then:
1. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/new-video.mjs 24-one-time-bundle my-video`
2. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video` to list the variables.
3. Write values.json, keeping each value close to its default's length and format (the same number of |-separated items, plain numbers where the default is a number), then apply it with `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video values.json`.
4. `cd my-video && npx hyperframes@0.8.96 snapshot --at 1,5,10,14`, look at every frame, and fix any text that overflows or any colour that is hard to read.
5. `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 render -f 60 -q high -w 4 -o out.mp4`, then watch it through once before you hand it over.

Template notes: Card names and prices in the opening pile live in the CARDS array; the screenshot wall is drawn on canvas from the SHOTS functions, and the feature chips come from FEATS. Keep the four tool slides in sync with the four product names. Never attach a real brand's customer count, rating or guarantee unless they are true.
